summary: @ornikar/browserslist-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute opaque obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as a static browserslist config but declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is an obfuscator.io-style script (hex-prefixed identifiers like `_0x488df8`, per-function string dictionaries) that at `npm install` time downloads Bun v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with heavy string-array-rotation obfuscation. The alien-runtime choice specifically executes code the Node loader would not evaluate and defeats Node-based static inspection. A browserslist config has no legitimate need for a preinstall hook, a second language runtime, or a 727 KB compiled payload. The advertised purpose does not match the shipped install-time behavior; the obfuscation of the loader has no build-tooling justification.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
